# GSAP browser distribution

Pinned version: **3.15.1**. Files copied without modification from the official `gsap` npm package (`dist/gsap.min.js` and `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.1.tgz
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

Original copyright/license banners are retained in both distributions. These files are served locally so the GitHub Pages invitation needs no CDN, package manager, framework, or build step at runtime.
